testCases.scenario: Soft-delete customer without child orders and verify Deleted tab + audit stamp
testCases.expectedResult: Customer moves to Deleted tab with DELETE user and timestamp logged
testCases.actualResult: Customer moved to Deleted tab with audit stamp recorded

testCases.expectedResult: Product returns to Active list with RESTORE audit stamp

testCases.expectedResult: System prevents deletion and displays active related records warning
testCases.actualResult: Blocked with 'Cannot delete row: active related record(s) still exist'
